## Department page (https://ivsp.umd.edu/)

INDIVIDUAL STUDIES PROGRAM
DESIGN YOUR OWN MAJOR
The Individual Studies Program (IVSP) lets UMD students create interdisciplinary majors that blend courses and experiential learning to pursue their academic interests and career goals.
Interested in learning more about IVSP?
PROGRAM INFO SESSIONS
Introductory Workshops: Introductory workshops are held virtually on Wednesdays from 11:00 am – 12:00 pm (beginning September 9, 2026) and in our office on Fridays 12:00 – 3:00 pm (beginning September 11, 2026). Please sign up for the virtual workshop. Fridays are drop-in hours.
Peer Mentoring Sessions: Peer Mentoring Sessions are held Fridays 12:00 – 3:00, and are based on student availability.
We also have one-on-one appointments available. Please make your appointment by calling 301-314-0023 or emailing individualstudies@umd.edu.
